Upper Text: 〔Digivolve〕 Lv.6 w/[Xros Heart]/[Blue Flare] trait: Cost 2

[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon to the bottom of the deck. Then, this Digimon may unsuspend.

[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by DigiXros, from this Digimon's digivolution cards, you may place up to 4 [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait Digimon cards under 1 of your Tamers and play 1 such card without paying the cost.
